description: This Java class 'LwM2mClient' manages LwM2M client state, resources, session info, and interactions within the Thingsboard platform, including resource management, session handling, and supported object versioning.

classes.name: LwM2mClient
classes.description: Manages LwM2M client state, resources, session info, and interactions within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the client session and device info based on credentials and session ID.
